description: Get the details of one campground in the US, Canada, New Zealand or Australia: its booking system, how far ahead sites go on sale, site count and types, stay limits, season and closures. Use it after search_campgrounds, or when the person names a specific campground. Says whether PermitSnag can send an alert when a site opens, and whether our checks count individual sites or only the campground as a whole. To set one up in the person's own PermitSnag account, use create_alert (it asks the person to sign in to PermitSnag).
name: get_campground_details

outputSchema.description: The details of one campground (US, Canada, New Zealand or Australia), or found: false.

available.description: True only when PermitSnag can send an alert for this place right now.

pageUrl.description: The PermitSnag page where an alert is set up, or where to read what to do instead.

reason.description: Why an alert is or is not on offer.

country.description: The country: US, CA (Canada), NZ (New Zealand) or AU (Australia).

depth.description: site_level: our checks count individual sites. campground_level: the booking system reports the campground as a whole.

found.description: Present, and false, only when nothing matched.

region.description: Outside the US, the province, state or territory as a slug.

releaseRule.description: When sites go on sale, from the listing itself.

season.description: The agency's season or closure state, with agency words in quoted fields.

closedParts.description: Named parts that are closed while the rest stays open.

closesOn.description: YYYY-MM-DD the agency says the season closes.

closure.description: A closure of the whole place, when the agency posted one.

offer.description: What the page offers in this season.

opensOn.description: YYYY-MM-DD the agency says the season opens.

state.description: The season state code, or null when nothing is published.
The US state; null outside the US.

title: Campground details
